papers.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
papers.summary_zh: 测试时扩展需生成大量候选解，但全部运行到完成计算开销大，现有基于质量或多样性的前缀剪枝策略未能直接权衡探索与利用。本文提出直接优化pass@k的剪枝方法，通过选择使至少一个部分解续写后得到正确答案概率最大的候选池，让质量与多样性由目标函数自然平衡。在八个开源推理模型上，该方法优于现有质量型和多样性型剪枝策略，在保留中等数量候选解时增益尤为显著。
papers.summary_en: Test-time scaling requires generating many candidate solutions, but running all to completion is costly, and existing quality- or diversity-based prefix pruning strategies do not directly expose the exploration-exploitation trade-off. This paper introduces a pruning procedure that directly optimizes pass@k over the selected pool, choosing candidates to maximize the probability that at least one partial solution yields a correct answer when continued, so quality and diversity are balanced by the objective itself. On eight open-weight reasoning models, the method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies, with particularly pronounced gains when a moderate number of partial solutions is retained.
highlights_zh: 直接优化pass@k统一平衡质量与多样性
八个开源推理模型上超越现有剪枝策略
中等保留数时增益显著，计算开销更低

papers.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
papers.abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
papers.summary_zh: 错误路由IT工单的代价可能高于人工分诊，因此需要评估模型在显式成本下何时应弃权转人工。本文提出成本感知弃权作为离线、成本条件的就绪度评估框架：在校准数据上按给定成本选择路由策略，再在留出测试集上一次性评估冻结策略，并比较四种非LLM分类器与四种LLM在零样本/少样本提示下的表现。在47,837条八类工单上，TF-IDF+逻辑回归以0.60阈值将测试成本从0.763降至0.472（相对降38.1%），错误路由从15.3%降至3.5%，但提示式LLM准确率仅0.477远低于微调DistilBERT的0.879，说明该框架用于评估而非通用部署认证。
papers.summary_en: Wrong automatic routing of IT tickets can cost more than human triage, motivating cost-aware abstention. The paper frames abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate the frozen policy once on held-out test data, comparing four non-LLM classifiers with four LLMs under zero- and few-shot prompting. On a 47,837-ticket eight-class corpus, TF-IDF with logistic regression at a calibration-selected 0.60 threshold cut test cost from 0.763 to 0.472 (38.1% relative reduction) and wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%, while the best prompted LLM reached only 0.477 accuracy versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT, showing the work is an evaluation framework rather than a new abstention algorithm or deployment certification.
highlights_zh: 校准选策略、测试集冻结评估的成本感知弃权框架
提示LLM准确率仅0.477，远低于微调BERT的0.879

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人基础模型通常依赖昂贵的闭环rollout评估，亟需低成本的离线代理指标。作者提出免训练的传感器运动对齐指标S²，衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何的对齐程度，将柏拉图表征假说扩展到具身模型。实验表明S²与下游任务成功率正相关，可在闭环评估前筛选模型和VLM骨干，并为VLA与WAM现象提供表征层面解释。
papers.summary_en: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated via costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating cheap offline proxies for capability. The authors propose Sensorimotor Alignment (S²), a training-free offline metric measuring how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion, extending the Platonic Representation Hypothesis to embodied models. S² correlates positively with downstream task success, enables pre-finetuning selection of VLM backbones, and offers representation-level explanations for phenomena in VLAs and world action models.
highlights_zh: 免训练离线指标S²衡量感官-运动对齐
S²与下游机器人任务成功率正相关
可低成本预筛模型与VLM骨干

papers.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
papers.abstract: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adaptive representations. This paper quantifies a phase transition pattern in approximation bounds and observes analogous behavior in training errors: a rapid but smooth initial improvement followed by diminishing returns, with a sharper transition under greater initialization mismatch. Under polynomial spectral decay with exponent $α>1$ and leverage compatibility, we establish a squared $L_2$ approximation rate $\mathcal{O}((κ_P\log(m/δ)/m)^α)$ for two-layer networks of width $m$ and trainable proportion $P$, where $κ_P=(P/κ_1^*+(1-P)/κ_0^*)^{-1}$. The bound holds uniformly over the unit ball of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with probability at least $1-δ$. The constants $κ_0^*$ and $κ_1^*$ quantify the fixed and trainable groups' sampling mismatches relative to the target RKHS. For spherical biased-ReLU features in dimension $d$, we verify these assumptions with $α=(d+2)/(d-1)$ and $κ_0^*=4\sqrt{2}τ(d+1)/d$ for initialization scale $τ\ge1$, and $κ_1^*=1$ under ridge leverage sampling. For $d=5$ and $τ=10$, a trainable proportion of approximately $4.1\%$ captures $90\%$ of the reduction in the approximation bound from $P=0$ to $P=1$. A structured three-layer example illustrates how a few trainable first-layer neurons exploit fixed downstream blocks through nonlinear composition. Numerical experiments across diverse settings, including networks with up to 15 layers, exhibit similar phase transitions in training errors.
papers.summary_zh: 部分可训练网络介于固定随机特征与全自适应表示之间，但其近似界如何随可训练比例变化尚缺乏定量刻画。本文在多项式谱衰减与杠杆兼容假设下，为宽度m、可训练比例P的两层网络建立了平方L2近似率O((κ_P log(m/δ)/m)^α)，其中κ_P由固定组与可训练组相对目标RKHS的采样失配常数κ_0^*、κ_1^*调和组合而成，并对球面偏置ReLU特征验证了假设（α=(d+2)/(d-1)）。结果表明近似界与训练误差均呈现快速改善后收益递减的相变模式，初始化失配越大转变越陡，且约4.1%的可训练比例即可获得从P=0到P=1总改善的90%，为部分微调策略提供了理论依据。
papers.summary_en: Partially trainable networks interpolate between fixed random features and fully adaptive representations, yet how their approximation bounds vary with the trainable proportion was not quantified. Under polynomial spectral decay and leverage compatibility, this paper establishes a squared L2 approximation rate O((κ_P log(m/δ)/m)^α) for two-layer networks of width m and trainable proportion P, where κ_P combines the fixed and trainable groups' sampling-mismatch constants κ_0^*, κ_1^* relative to the target RKHS, and verifies the assumptions for spherical biased-ReLU features with α=(d+2)/(d-1). The bounds and training errors both exhibit a rapid-then-saturating phase transition that sharpens with greater initialization mismatch, and about 4.1% trainable proportion captures 90% of the total improvement from P=0 to P=1, offering theoretical guidance for partial fine-tuning.
highlights_zh: 给出依赖可训练比例P的显式近似率界
4.1%可训练比例即达90%改善
为部分微调策略提供理论依据

papers.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
papers.summary_zh: 近期开源语言模型常用n-gram嵌入表提升性能，但其内存开销巨大（如DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的Engram表占1960亿参数）。作者提出以低精度存储n-gram嵌入，并系统研究不同量化方法与各表比特分配策略。实验表明4比特表可节省约75%表内存且保留超99%的验证损失改善，在大型现有模型上节省47-55%内存而困惑度仅升不到1.2%。
papers.summary_en: Recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables for performance gains but incur huge memory costs (e.g., DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash allocates 196B parameters to its Engram table). The authors propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically study quantization methods and per-table bit allocation. Four-bit tables save ~75% of table memory while preserving over 99% of validation-loss improvement, and on large existing models they save 47-55% of table memory with under 1.2% perplexity increase.
highlights_zh: 低比特量化n-gram嵌入表
4比特省75%内存保99%收益
大模型省47-55%内存

papers.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
papers.abstract: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \$2.21-\$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline's filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \$12k-\$90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: 多语言语料流水线（如FineWeb2）用同一配方处理上千种语言，导致个别语言的失效模式难以预料。作者将LLM用作语料调试器而非分类器，让工具型智能体通过只读、有预算的API探索语料，把每个发现编译成可执行测试，再由母语者验证。在2650万文档的斯洛伐克语部分，三次运行（每次2.21-2.84美元）发现四类现象下的七个问题，最大的是140万文档（5.32%）的机器生成内容农场通过了过滤，编译测试套件0.7秒扫完全库且无需GPU，远低于LLM分类的1.2万-9万美元成本。
papers.summary_en: Multilingual pipelines like FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving individual languages' failure modes unanticipated. The authors use an LLM once as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus via a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test validated by a native speaker. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion, three runs costing $2.21-$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena, including a 1,408,437-document (5.32%) machine-generated content farm that passed the pipeline's filters; the compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s without a GPU versus $12k-$90k per LLM classification pass.
highlights_zh: LLM作语料调试器并编译可执行测试
0.7秒无GPU扫全库，成本远低于LLM
智能体成本高于静态采样基线
highlights_en: LLM as corpus debugger compiling executable tests
0.7s GPU-free full-corpus scan, far cheaper than LLM
Agent costs more than static sampling baseline

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
papers.abstract: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart
papers.summary_zh: 现有可控3D部件生成方法缺乏灵活性，难以适应需要不同控制程度的多样用户工作流。本文提出FlexPart，一个统一图像到3D部件生成框架，通过门控自适应调制无缝整合从稀疏点到密集边界框和掩码的异构输入，并引入非对称几何引导机制对齐跨粒度表示。在PartVerseXL掩码条件下，FlexPart相较TripoSG+SAM3D降低部件CD 16.6%、相较OmniPart降低10.5%，同时保持有竞争力的整体网格质量。
papers.summary_en: Existing controllable 3D part generation methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. We introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that seamlessly integrates heterogeneous inputs from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks via gated adaptive modulation, and proposes an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism to align representations across granularities. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG+SAM3D and 10.5% relative to OmniPart while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality.
highlights_zh: 单模型支持变粒度几何条件
部件CD降低16.6%
助力数字资产可控创建

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
papers.summary_zh: 视频基础模型与视频世界模型目标不同但都涉及视频观测与演化世界的关系，本文以世界建模为统一视角综述该领域。将观测视频视为潜在时序世界的部分、有损、时序投影，围绕读、写、共享、交互四种互补操作组织文献，并区分序列时序一致性与底层世界状态一致性。梳理了从片段级识别与感知保真向持久状态、可控演化、物理因果有效性和交互式评估的转变，并提炼开放挑战。
papers.summary_en: Video foundation models and video world models pursue different goals but both concern the relation between video observations and an evolving world, and this survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens. Treating observed video as a partial, lossy, temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, it organizes the literature around four complementary operations—reading, writing, sharing, and interacting—and distinguishes temporal coherence in sequences from consistency of the underlying world state. It traces a shift from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and interaction-grounded evaluation, and distills open challenges.
highlights_zh: 以世界建模统一视频理解与生成
提出读/写/共享/交互四操作框架
区分序列一致性与世界状态一致性

papers.title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
papers.abstract: We present OpenTac, a novel sensor and a full-stack ecosystem for tactile skins that are highly customizable, scalable, and readily deployed in downstream robot control and learning applications. Our core contribution is twofold. First, we develop a scalable resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure. Differential responses across neighboring "taxels" support decoding of local shear vectors, and the common-mode response encodes normal force. Second, we provide a highly customizable sensor design tool that is able to automatically generate fabrication files for these tactile skins from 2D outlines and developable 3D surfaces, including from abstract descriptions such as text (e.g., "design a sensor for a size 9 shoe insole"). We develop an ecosystem around the OpenTac sensor, including the CAD design tool, a sensor simulator, cross-sensor transfer, and fast/adaptive data acquisition. We demonstrate the broad applicability of the OpenTac-CAD sensor design tool by designing and fabricating more than 30 sensors across a variety of robot embodiments. We characterize the three-dimensional tactile fields produced by OpenTac with a commercial, high-precision force/torque sensor. We demonstrate the broad applicability of 3D tactile sensing across contact-rich feedback control and manipulation policy learning on four real-world robot embodiments. Additionally, adaptive acquisition enables kilohertz-rate partial readouts, exceeding full-array raster scanning on the same sensor by 19.2X at 16 sampled taxels per update for a 1024-taxel skin. We provide all hardware, software, and result videos are at opentac.github.io
papers.summary_zh: 机器人触觉皮肤难以兼顾可定制性、可扩展性与下游控制学习的可迁移性。OpenTac提出结构化可变形覆盖层的电阻式触觉皮肤，通过相邻taxel差分响应解码局部剪切、共模响应编码法向力，并提供从2D轮廓、可展3D曲面乃至文本描述自动生成制造文件的设计工具及仿真、跨传感器迁移与自适应采集生态。在30余种机器人构型上设计制造传感器，并在四个真实机器人平台上验证了接触丰富控制与操作策略学习，自适应采集在1024-taxel皮肤上以16 taxel/次更新实现比全阵列扫描快19.2X的千赫兹级部分读出。
papers.summary_en: Tactile skins for robots struggle to be simultaneously customizable, scalable, and transferable to downstream control and learning. OpenTac introduces a resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure, decoding local shear via differential taxel responses and normal force via common-mode response, together with a design tool that auto-generates fabrication files from 2D outlines, developable 3D surfaces, or text prompts, plus simulation, cross-sensor transfer, and adaptive acquisition. Over 30 sensors were designed and fabricated across robot embodiments and validated on four real platforms for contact-rich control and manipulation policy learning, with adaptive acquisition achieving kilohertz-rate partial readouts 19.2X faster than full-array raster scanning at 16 taxels per update on a 1024-taxel skin.
highlights_zh: 结构化覆盖层差分解码三维力
1024 taxel皮肤读取提速19.2倍
跨30余种机器人构型可定制部署

papers.title: Extending Harmonic Function Methods via Root Locus for Coordinated Path Generation
papers.abstract: We consider the offline generation of coordinated paths for N interchangeable robots and N goals in planar environments with polygonal obstacles. After a conformal map to a circular domain, starts and goals become the poles and zeros of a rational function R, and the paths are the branches of its Generalized Root Locus (GRL), i.e. the streamlines of the logarithmic potential -log R. We show that, for every phase outside a finite set of critical phases and a set of boundary phases, the induced gradient motion drives each robot to a distinct goal along pairwise disjoint paths that never reach the obstacles; the robot-goal assignment is produced by the construction, and with the gain used as a clock all robots move as the closed-loop roots of the GRL and arrive together at a prescribed time. Obstacles become streamlines through successive Milne-Thomson reflections, and for a finite number of reflections a finite test certifies safety for the potential that is actually computed. Reciprocal root-locus planning is recovered as a special case. The method is illustrated on two polygonal workspaces, 100 random instances compared with independent harmonic planning and artificial potentials, and a scene with ten robots and ten obstacles.
papers.summary_zh: 针对平面多边形障碍环境中N个可互换机器人与N个目标点的离线协调路径生成问题，现有调和函数方法在路径分配与安全性保证上存在局限。该论文通过共形映射将起点和目标转化为有理函数的极点与零点，利用广义根轨迹的支路作为路径，并借助Milne-Thomson反射处理障碍，以增益作为时钟实现同步到达。实验在两组多边形场景、100个随机实例及十机器人十障碍场景中验证了方法能生成互不相交、避障且同时到达的路径，且包含有限反射下的安全性检验，推广了倒数根轨迹规划。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses offline coordinated path generation for N interchangeable robots and N goals in planar environments with polygonal obstacles, where existing harmonic-function planners lack assignment and safety guarantees. After a conformal map to a circular domain, starts and goals become poles and zeros of a rational function, and paths are branches of its Generalized Root Locus (streamlines of -log R), with obstacles handled by successive Milne-Thomson reflections and a finite safety test, while the gain acts as a clock for synchronized arrival. The method is validated on two polygonal workspaces, 100 random instances against independent harmonic planning and artificial potentials, and a ten-robot ten-obstacle scene, yielding disjoint collision-free paths with construction-induced assignment and recovering reciprocal root-locus planning as a special case.
